execute: Find the actual actor-action-object rule, including tenant, application, sharing and identity class. Validate each identity on its own permitted operation. Choose one matrix cell distinguishing scope failure from invalid identity, public behavior, malformed input or intended sharing. Use a valid operation and authorized plus invalid/absent-identity controls. Preserve method, parameters, body, media type, session and business readback. Compare verified effective scopes, not token prefixes, names or decoded labels. Avoid inferring annotations from status ratios. GET does not establish absence of side effects.
review: Support a scope violation only with a valid actor's forbidden business result and applicable rule. Missing-annotation explanations require deployed implementation linkage. A valid denial refutes that operation under its conditions; unknown policy, identity or request validity stays inconclusive. Stop when the selected cell is answered or shared validity fails; reopen affected scope, method, sharing, template or deployment only.
